options.name: Product adapts to bridge
options.summary: Product-side pre-bridge stage emits legacy bridge-conformant inputs while existing bridge contract remains unchanged.
risks: Requires legacy operator approval shape that is not product Karl approval
Unblocked bridge path can invoke runner

options.name: Additive bridge product-mode contract
options.summary: Bridge keeps legacy behavior unchanged by default and adds an explicit strict product invocation mode.
benefits: Bridge remains source of bridge validation truth
No product-side copy of bridge behavior
Product approval and scratch semantics become first-class
risks: Tests must prove legacy behavior unchanged

options.name: Bridge preparation / runner execution split
options.summary: Expose a no-runner bridge preparation contract and leave runner execution to separate authorization.
benefits: Supports product bridge stage without canonical or runner side effects
risks: Current repo has no public preparation-only mode
Requires careful contract tests against hidden runner invocation

options.name: Product-side reimplementation
options.summary: Recreate bridge behavior inside the lab product flow.
benefits: Could keep product outputs package-local without modifying bridge
